_readme: Pre-registered benchmark scorecard for SnowWatch. Committed 2026-07-06,
BEFORE the v1.6 event-detection retrains, so the win conditions cannot be
moved after seeing results. Every claim of a win must satisfy the stated
condition on the fold of record (A_core_winter) with the stated
significance test. Metrics reference implementation: app/verification.py.

truths.T2: NOHRSC National Snowfall Analysis v2, grid-to-point at station coords — comparability (CONUS only, added Phase 4)

baselines.nbm_raw: NBM snowfall verbatim at station point (headline baseline)
baselines.nbm_tuned: NBM with per-threshold CSI-optimal decision thresholds chosen on the calibration period (fair-fight variant; report both)
baselines.climatology: per-(station, month) empirical quantiles from the training period (verification.climatology_quantiles)

significance.mae_crps_deltas: paired station-week block bootstrap (verification.paired_block_bootstrap), 95% CI excluding 0
significance.event_stat_deltas: station-week block bootstrap of the statistic difference (verification.block_bootstrap_stat), 95% CI excluding 0

W1.claim: MAE <= 0.85 x NBM MAE, CI excludes 0
W1.status_at_registration: already met on melt-season fold (0.61x); must hold on fold A

W2.claim: CSI >= nbm_raw at 1/2/6/12 in with frequency bias in [0.8, 1.3] at each threshold
W2.status_at_registration: NOT met: postproc loses CSI/POD at every threshold >= 1in (POD@6in 0.035 vs 0.351); the central gap this program exists to close
W2.phase_1_interim_gate: CSI@1/2/6 >= nbm_raw; CSI@12 >= 0.5 x nbm_raw (full parity at 12in expected to need Phase 2 data volume)

W3.claim: CRPSS vs climatology at/above the Scheuerer & Hamill 2019 skill band on NOHRSC truth; CRPS < Gaussian-dressed NBM baseline
W3.status_at_registration: not yet measurable (NOHRSC truth lands Phase 4; CRPSS-vs-climatology plumbing added Phase 0)

W4.claim: BSS > 0 at 1/2/6/12 in with reliability slope in [0.9, 1.1]
W4.status_at_registration: psnow@1in Brier 0.0586 well-calibrated; 2/6/12 in heads do not exist yet (Phase 1)

W5.claim: STRETCH: predicted-SLR R^2 >= 0.43 and MAE <= 2.94 on corroborated obs-SLR days (same metric as Veals et al. 2025, different site set — label as such)
W5.status_at_registration: no SLR prediction head; profile features not wired (Phase 3)

nbm_raw_internal.source: SnowWatch metrics.json 2026-06-15, 98 stations, melt-season fold (re-baselined on fold A in baseline_v1.5.json)

veals_2025_slr.source: Veals et al. 2025, Weather and Forecasting, DOI 10.1175/WAF-D-24-0233.1
veals_2025_slr.method: random forest SLR, 14 manual western-US mountain sites
veals_2025_slr.note: CONUS follow-up (~900 CoCoRaHS sites) expected 2026 — re-pin when published

scheuerer_hamill_2019.source: Scheuerer & Hamill 2019, Monthly Weather Review — GEFS probabilistic 24h snowfall vs NOHRSC analysis
scheuerer_hamill_2019.note: skill quoted vs NOHRSC truth; comparable only after Phase 4 NOHRSC ingestion. Pin exact CRPSS/BSS values from the paper when the NOHRSC eval mode exists.

uden_2023.source: Uden et al. 2023, Weather and Forecasting 38(8), DOI 10.1175/WAF-D-22-0170.1 — NBM/SREF/HRRRE snow events, 24 Intermountain West airports vs METAR
uden_2023.note: NBM systematically underconfident (reliability above diagonal); context for W4, not a direct target (different truth/sites)
